newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $74.8 million of Treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $74.8 million of Treasury bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all the 1.5 billion rupees ($74.8 million) of treasury bills that it put on tender on Friday, the central bank said.

The central bank said it auctioned 409.0 million rupees of 91-day, 412.0 million rupees of 182-day and 679.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 10.58 percent, 10.76 percent and 10.86 percent respectively.
This week's effective bank rate rose to 10.76 percent per annum from 10.64 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the Bank of Mauritius sold 1.0 billion rupees of 91, 182 and 364 day Treasury Bills with weighted yields of 10.45 percent, 10.67 percent and 10.80 percent respectively.
